description: This file defines the MacNodeModeCoordinator class, which manages the lifecycle and connection logic for a macOS node in a distributed system. It handles starting and stopping tasks, managing gateway sessions, reconnect logic, capability detection, and event handling for the node.

classes.name: MacNodeModeCoordinator
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing the macOS node's connection to the gateway, handling capabilities, permissions, and session lifecycle.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the main task for managing the node's connection workflow.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the main task and disconnects the session.

methods.name: setPreferredGatewayStableID
methods.description: Sets a preferred stable ID for gateway discovery and disconnects the current session.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main loop that manages reconnection logic, capability checks, and session lifecycle.

methods.name: currentCaps
methods.description: Determines the current capabilities of the node based on configuration and user defaults.

methods.name: currentCommands
methods.description: Generates the list of commands supported based on current capabilities.

methods.name: buildSessionBox
methods.description: Constructs a WebSocket session box configured with TLS parameters based on the URL.
